## famine — talking to Pablo
> YOU PICK [betrayal:accept] 
YOU: "Sure."
NPC: "Here. I made an extra." Pablo presses something into your hand — a decent tool, oiled and kept. (Useful. Keep it.)

> YOU PICK [alive:event:mourning] 
YOU: "What’s going on out there?"
NPC: "Karen is gone and the world just... continues. That's the part I can't stand."

> YOU PICK [alive:thread:want] 
YOU: "About that favor — we never finished."
NPC: "My stomach's been empty so long I've stopped feeling it, and that's worse. I can't pull my weight like this. Anything you can spare, I'll make it stretch."

> YOU PICK [alive:thread:lately] 
YOU: "About what's been happening — we never finished."
NPC: "Sleep's gone strange. I wake before anyone else at odd hours now. Whatever gets me to morning."

> YOU PICK [dlg:more] 
YOU: "Tell me more."
NPC: "Nobody says Karen's name right yet. We will. Give it a few days."

> YOU PICK [dlg:more] 
NPC: "I'm picking up Karen's share of the work. Someone should, and it might as well be me."
NPC: "I should get back to it."

> YOU PICK [dlg:more] 
(conversation ended by the engine)

## famine — talking to Quinn
> YOU PICK [gq:open:take] 
YOU: "What do you think?"
NPC: "I think the asking matters more than the answer, out here. That's my read."

> YOU PICK [dlg:details] 
YOU: "Tell me more about it."
NPC: "My stomach's been empty so long I've stopped feeling it, and that's worse. I'm slowing down — stupid, clumsy. Help me get back on my feet."

> YOU PICK [alive:event:mourning] 
YOU: "What’s going on out there?"
NPC: "Since Karen died... I keep expecting to see Karen at the fire. Stupid."

> YOU PICK [alive:thread:want] 
YOU: "About that favor — we never finished."
NPC: "I just said — did you miss it?"

> YOU PICK [alive:thread:lately] 
YOU: "About what's been happening — we never finished."
NPC: "I do push-ups at dawn. It doesn't bring anyone back. It just keeps my hands from shaking."

> YOU PICK [dlg:more] 
YOU: "Tell me more."
NPC: "The fire feels smaller without Karen. The rest of us will have to be bigger."

> YOU PICK [dlg:more] 
YOU: "Tell me more."
NPC: "My part? I remember them. Someone has to do it properly."

> YOU PICK [dlg:more] 
YOU: "Tell me more."
NPC: "I wish there was more to tell. That's it."

> YOU PICK [dlg:react] 
YOU: "Huh."
NPC: "Well." A breath. "That's where things stand."

> YOU PICK [dlg:react] 
NPC: "So." They look at the fire for a moment.
NPC: "I wish we had longer. Soon, yeah?"

## famine — talking to Dmitri
> YOU PICK [dlg:help] 
YOU: "How can I help?"
NPC: "The stores won't stretch past tomorrow, and I'm not choosing who eats. Nobody's worked where the mayapple grows thick in days. We'll fill packs before dark."

> YOU PICK [betrayal:accept] 
YOU: "Sure."
NPC: "I buried this before the Scattering. Seemed stupid to keep it secret." Dmitri digs up a wrapped bundle — food, still good. (+1776 kcal to the pantry.)

> YOU PICK [alive:event:mourning] 
YOU: "What’s going on out there?"
NPC: "...Actually, forget it."

> YOU PICK [alive:thread:want] 
YOU: "About that favor — we never finished."
NPC: "I just said — did you miss it?"

> YOU PICK [alive:thread:lately] 
YOU: "About what's been happening — we never finished."
NPC: "I keep turning over the last thing Karen said to me. I can't tell if I'm remembering it right, and that's somehow the worst part."

> YOU PICK [dlg:more] 
YOU: "Tell me more."
NPC: "We bury, we grieve, we keep going. There's no step four."

> YOU PICK [dlg:more] 
YOU: "Tell me more."
NPC: "I clean up other people's messes quietly for Karen, now. Feels right. Feels like the least I can do."

> YOU PICK [dlg:more] 
YOU: "Tell me more."
NPC: "That's... pretty much all of it, honestly."

> YOU PICK [dlg:react] 
YOU: "I see."
NPC: They nod slowly, not quite done, not quite continuing.

> YOU PICK [dlg:react] 
NPC: "Anyway." A small smile.
NPC: "Okay. We'll pick this up later."
